design: Discovery-only weighted SVD of output derivatives. Shared pooled discovery probability metric. Fit20 contexts x5 directions globally,4x5 per task. Evaluate receiver-weighted optimal projections on all responses, report heldout contexts and heldout input directions separately.
limitations: Oracle coefficients fitted to each test response: representational upper bound, not prediction. Direction partition declared after H633 observations, so retrospective holdout, not a prospective blind replication. Initial fixed ranks1/4/16/32 and task20; global100 added as an exploratory full-discovery-span ceiling after inspecting initial results. No best-rank selection.
